title: Covered Reasons Matrix and Named Exclusions, Trip Protection
content:
Each Trip Protection plan lists the reasons for which cancellation and interruption are covered. The matrix below shows each reason against each plan, followed by the plan terms that qualify those reasons.

## Covered reasons by plan

| Reason | Trip Cancellation Only | Trip Protection Essential | Trip Protection Standard | Trip Protection Plus | Trip Protection Premier | Trip Protection Premier CFAR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Illness or injury | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Death in the family | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Severe weather | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Job loss | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Jury duty | not listed | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Home uninhabitable | not listed | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Military duty | not listed | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Any reason | not listed | not listed | not listed | not listed | not listed | covered |

## Qualifying terms by plan

| Plan | Months of continuous employment required for job loss | Storm named at least this many hours before purchase is not a covered reason | Illness from an epidemic disease is a covered illness | Being required to work is a covered reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 12 | 24 | no | no |
| Trip Protection Essential | 12 | 24 | yes | no |
| Trip Protection Standard | 12 | 24 | yes | no |
| Trip Protection Plus | 12 | 24 | yes | yes |
| Trip Protection Premier | 12 | 24 | yes | yes |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 12 | 24 | yes | yes |

## Reading the matrix

- A reason marked "not listed" is not among that plan's covered reasons.
- Job loss is a covered reason only with 12 months of continuous employment on every plan.
- A storm named 24 hours or more before the plan was bought is not a covered reason on any plan. On hypothetical timings: a storm named 30 hours before purchase is excluded; a storm named exactly 24 hours before purchase is excluded; a storm named 10 hours before purchase is not caught by this exclusion.
- Illness from an epidemic disease counts as a covered illness on every plan except Trip Cancellation Only.
- Being required to work is a covered reason on Trip Protection Plus, Trip Protection Premier and Trip Protection Premier CFAR only.
